distribution: 四川西昌邛海（海拔一千五百米）。
en: The account of this species in the present volume is fragmentary. The soldier and alate sections are occupied by the family description of the Termitidae and the generic diagnosis of Microcerotermes, together with a key to the genera, and only the figure caption and the type locality survive. The species is recorded from Qionghai, Xichang, Sichuan, at an elevation of about 1500 m. No morphological description of the soldier or the winged adult can therefore be given here, and the biology remains unknown.
